smarts_or_definition: Hall-Kier alpha: sum of per-atom polarisability corrections relative to sp3 carbon; becomes more negative with more sp3/small atoms and less negative with heavy, polarisable or unsaturated atoms
n_marine_carrying_definition: marine compounds with HallKierAlpha <= -3.61 (median of ChEMBL actives; actives skew low)

smarts_or_definition: Wildman-Crippen atom-contribution estimate of log P(octanol/water) (Crippen.MolLogP)
n_marine_carrying_definition: marine compounds with MolLogP >= 4.344 (median of ChEMBL actives; actives skew high)

smarts_or_definition: Balaban J index: average distance-sum connectivity of the molecular graph
n_marine_carrying_definition: marine compounds with BalabanJ <= 1.531 (median of ChEMBL actives; actives skew low)

smarts_or_definition: Number of hydrogen-bond acceptors, Lipinski definition (CalcNumHBA)
n_marine_carrying_definition: marine compounds with NumHAcceptors >= 7 (median of ChEMBL actives; actives skew high)

smarts_or_definition: Third-order Kier-Hall kappa shape index (centrality of branching)
n_marine_carrying_definition: marine compounds with Kappa3 >= 4.791 (median of ChEMBL actives; actives skew high)

smarts_or_definition: Quantitative estimate of drug-likeness, 0-1 (Bickerton et al. 2012)
n_marine_carrying_definition: marine compounds with QED <= 0.4217 (median of ChEMBL actives; actives skew low)

smarts_or_definition: Second-order Kier-Hall kappa shape index (spatial density, degree of branching)
n_marine_carrying_definition: marine compounds with Kappa2 >= 9.354 (median of ChEMBL actives; actives skew high)
